'''The Wind's Favor''' is an inn located in [[Bandar Eban]].{{ref|{{twotc}}, Wind's Favor, The}} The owner is [[Quillin Tasil]], an [[Andoran]]. Quillin is an agent for [[Cadsuane Melaidhrin]] and his daughter is [[Namine Tasil]], an [[Aes Sedai]] of the [[Brown Ajah]].
